answer: A newcomer earns entry by keeping a sable-stamped pulse log for a month: each day it publishes a summary of one task listed in the atlas of verified work, with the client's receipt attached. Two atlas stewards check the log against the client's record within three days, signing only when work, date, and receipt match. A missing pulse, copied entry, or reused receipt voids the log and bars its sponsor for a season. One honest log costs a month of real work; a thousand fakes need a thousand months of matched receipts and checks, all open to contradiction.
